title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in PHP AetherScript: A Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
topic: AetherScript: A Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: AetherScript is a PHP-based generative transformer that encodes online handwriting strokes and sketches into compact embeddings and decodes them into practical sequences. The core of AetherScript is a balanced search and indexing structure that stores positional embeddings in a height-balanced binary tree, enabling logarithmic-time point and range queries during self-attention. We formally prove that the tree maintains the strict height-balance and key-ordered invariants after every insertion and rebalancing step, guaranteeing $O(\log N)$ search and $O(\log N)$ update complexity. Static abstract syntax tree analysis confirms that the implementation occupies 241 source lines and 32 function blocks, with contiguous node layout for spatial locality. No empirical wall-clock measurements are reported; all claims are supported by formal proofs and AST profiling. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261125_150215_aetherscript__a_generative_tra}
